info.name: BookingQube Customer Checkout, POS & Cafe
info.description:
Folder-wise APIs for BookingQube V2.

**Customer (Next.js website):** 01–06
**POS:** 07 — auth, tickets, book, advances, customers, online tickets, daily closing/shift
**Cafe POS:** CAFE — auth, menu, tables, report, daily closings (uses cafePosToken)

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Public — register, login, social login, password reset OTP

request.description: Creates account. Does not return JWT — call Login next.
Returns JWT in `token`. Test script saves it to environment.
`other_data` must be a JSON **string**. Providers: google | apple.
OTP is exactly 6 digits.

item.name: 02 Browse Catalog
item.description: Public browse — homepage, listing, detail, schedule, tickets, content pages (as used by Next.js customer site)

request.description: Includes payment_methods from admin-enabled gateways (myfatoorah→10/11/12, qpay→7, mastercard→8).
`date` and `time` are required. Saves first ticket id to `ticketId` if present.
Homepage offer / promotion detail page.

Static CMS pages (FAQ, terms, privacy, etc.).

**Not migrated** — Nest returns HTTP 501:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "not in system",
  "data": null
}
```
Private event unlock. Response may include access_token used as X-Event-Access-Token on detail/tickets/book.

item.name: 03 Registration Events
item.description: Alternate checkout for registration-only events

request.description: Field keys depend on form definition from Get Registration Form.

item.name: 04 Promocodes
item.description: Validate promo before book-ticket (Next.js checkout)

item.name: 05 Checkout Book Pay
item.description: Customer web checkout as used by Next.js: book-ticket + MyFatoorah embedded + QPay. Optional Bearer.

request.description: Optional Bearer. Used for free / offline / after MyFatoorah confirm. Next.js posts via BFF /api/v2/book-ticket.
Starts MyFatoorah Embedded Payment v3 sessions. Bearer usually required. Used by Next.js checkout before rendering payment widgets.
Confirms gateway payment after embedded widget success. Then call Book Ticket with providerResponse from this response.
Signed QPay session params for Next.js /qpay-redirect auto-POST form. No JWT.

item.name: 06 Customer Account
item.description: Bearer JWT required — profile, favorites, bookings

request.description: Next.js sends event_id. Nest also accepts slug.
Path param is event UUID/id, not ticket id.
Next.js my-tickets download. Accept PDF or HTML; format=card|classic.

item.name: 07 POS Checkout
item.description: Event POS — auth, tickets, agents, promocodes, book-ticket, advances, customers, online tickets, daily closing/shift report

item.name: 00 POS Auth
item.description: Separate POS agent login — agent must be assigned to an event

request.description: Login with email or username + password. Response `data.event` includes currency and waiver fields. Saves `token`, `agentId`, `eventId`, `eventSlug`.

item.name: 00 POS Tickets
item.description: Tickets for the logged-in agent's assigned event (hide_from_pos excluded)

request.description: Also returns addons and time_extensions. Excludes hide_from_pos. Shareholder agents only see their vendors' tickets. Waiver fields are on login data.event.

item.name: 01 POS Agents
item.description: List POS staff assigned to an event

request.description: Requires event_slug or event_id. Saves first agent to `agentId`.

item.name: 01 POS Promocodes
item.description: Validate promo before POS book-ticket (same rules as customer /promocodes/apply)

request.description: GET /pos/promocodes/offers — offers visible to this POS agent/ticket scope.
Same response as customer apply. With POS JWT, event_slug is optional.

item.name: 02 POS Booking
item.description: Offline book-ticket — cash / card / split / advance / comp

request.description: `agent_id` + `offline_payment.mode` required. Set `ticketId` from event tickets API.
Creates pending advance. Complete remaining via folder 03.

item.name: 03 POS Advance Payments
item.description: Find pending advances and collect remaining payment

request.description: `search` should be non-empty (order no / customer).

item.name: 04 POS Customers
item.description: Search/resolve walk-in customers (age group + nationality options)

request.description: GET /pos/customers/options — age_groups and nationalities for POS forms.
GET /pos/customers/search — min 2 chars; name/email/phone. Saves posCustomerId.
POST /pos/customers/resolve — find or create customer for POS booking.

item.name: 05 POS Online Tickets
item.description: Search online bookings and mark tickets used (RFID/barcode)

request.description: GET /pos/online-tickets/search — phone, ticket code, common_order, or UUID (min 3 chars).
POST /pos/online-tickets/:id/use — optional rfids[]. Syncs attendance.

item.name: 06 POS Daily Closing (Shift)
item.description: Agent sales report + close shift (creates DailyClosing). Blocked after close.

request.description: GET /pos/shift — expected cash/card/ticket/addon totals for date (defaults to today Qatar). This is the POS agent sales report.
POST /pos/shift/close — creates DailyClosing for agent+event+date. Blocks further sales for that day.

item.name: CAFE
item.description: Dedicated cafe POS APIs — login, menu, tables, report, daily closings.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Cafe POS login (public) and session. Saves `cafePosToken`.

request.description: POST /pos/cafe/auth/login — returns JWT typ=cafe_pos_access. Pass cafe_id when agent has multiple cafes.
GET /pos/cafe/me — current cafe + event + agent from token.

item.name: Menu
item.description: List and create menu from POS. Requires Bearer {{cafePosToken}}.

request.description: GET /pos/cafe/menu — category.items = no subcategory; category.subcategories = named groups. Saves categoryId / subcategoryId / menuItemId when present.
POST /pos/cafe/menu/categories
POST /pos/cafe/menu/subcategories
POST /pos/cafe/menu/items — optional subcategory_id.

item.name: Tables & Orders
item.description: Table list, book lines, clear/settle. Requires Bearer {{cafePosToken}}.

request.description: GET /pos/cafe/tables
POST /pos/cafe/promocodes/apply — preview discount before book. Soft-fails with valid:false.
GET /pos/cafe/customers/search — search by name, email, or phone (min 2 chars).
POST /pos/cafe/orders — instant book+settle (cash/card/split). No open table cart.
POST /pos/cafe/tables/book — agent_id optional (from token).
POST /pos/cafe/tables/clear — cash | card | split.

item.name: Report
item.description: Agent-scoped cafe sales report.

request.description: POST /pos/cafe/report — optional category_id, menu_item_id.

item.name: Daily Closings
item.description: Daily closings for cafe POS agent on assigned event (DailyClosing model).

request.description: GET /pos/cafe/daily-closings
POST /pos/cafe/daily-closings
POST /pos/cafe/daily-closings/:id/note
